card.name: Scattered words after reported events
card.fires_on: Mixed words right after a statement that something occurred or was reported, such as a period after a clause, 'from' or 'at' after 'has occurred' or 'observed', and the middle of 'granulocytopenia'. No single word type fits all cases.

modes.label: Linking word after an occurrence
modes.description: A small word like 'from' or 'at' that follows a verb of occurrence or observation in adverse-reaction text.
modes.example: Localized infections of the nose and pharynx with Candida albicans has occurred<< from>> nasal administration of mometasone furo

modes.label: Sentence-ending period
modes.description: A period ending a short clause about something happening or not happening.
modes.example: these reactions occurred after the first dose<<.>> These hypersensitivity reactions included: anaph

modes.label: Inside blood-count words
modes.description: The middle of a long blood-disorder term.
modes.example: have been reported due to gran<<ul>>ocytopenia or pancyt

card.plain: It fires on assorted small words and punctuation after statements that a reaction or event occurred, with no single clear theme.
